title: Wh-questions with who, whom, which, how and whose
summary: Вопросы к подлежащему и к дополнению, who и whom, which против what, how с прилагательными и наречиями, how come, вопросы what…like и how…, а также whose.
ru:
## Вопрос к подлежащему и вопрос к дополнению
В вопросе **к подлежащему** вспомогательный глагол do не нужен: вопросительное слово само является подлежащим, порядок слов остаётся прямым.
> **Who called** you last night? — Кто звонил тебе вчера вечером?
> **What happened** to your car? — Что случилось с твоей машиной?
> **Which team won** the cup? — Какая команда выиграла кубок?
В вопросе **к дополнению** нужен вспомогательный глагол и инверсия:
> **Who did** you call last night? — Кому ты звонил?
> **What did** she say?
- ~~Who did call you?~~ → **Who called** you? (did допустим только для усиления: *Who did call?* = «Так кто же всё-таки звонил?»)
- ~~Which team did win?~~ → Which team **won**?

## who и whom
**Whom** — форма дополнения, она формальна и в разговоре почти исчезла. После предлога в строгом стиле нужна именно **whom**; в живой речи предлог уходит в конец, а who заменяет whom.
> **To whom** should the complaint be addressed? (формально)
> **Who** should I address the complaint **to**? (нейтрально)
- ~~To who did you speak?~~ → **To whom** did you speak?
- ~~Whom called?~~ → **Who** called? (whom никогда не бывает подлежащим)

## which и what
**Which** — выбор из **ограниченного, известного набора**: Which of these two routes is shorter? Which platform does the train leave from? **What** — открытый выбор: What kind of music do you like? What time is it?
- **which of** + the / these / them / us: Which **of the** candidates impressed you? (~~Which of candidates~~)
- **which one(s)** уместно, когда существительное уже ясно: Which one do you prefer?
- ~~What colour of car~~ → What **colour** is your car? / What **kind of** car is it?

## how: how + прилагательное или наречие
How + прилагательное/наречие спрашивает о степени: **how long** (длительность, длина), **how far**, **how often**, **how old**, **how tall**, **how fast**, **how well**, **how much / how many**.
> **How long** does the conference last? — **How often** do the trains run?
> **How well** do you know him?
Отдельно:
- **How come** + прямой порядок слов = «почему же»: **How come** you never told me? (без did!). ~~How come did you leave?~~ — неверно.
- **How about / What about** + -ing или существительное: How about **visiting** the museum?
- **What … like?** (характеристика) против **How …?** (состояние, мнение): **What is** your new boss **like**? — Какой он? **How is** your boss? — Как у него дела? **How do you like** it? — Как вам это (нравится ли)?

## whose
**Whose** + существительное спрашивает о принадлежности: Whose idea was it? Whose turn is it? Можно и без существительного: **Whose** is the red folder? Не путать с **who's** (= who is / who has).

## Усиление
Чтобы показать удивление или раздражение, добавляют **on earth / in the world / ever**: **What on earth** are you doing? **Who ever** said that?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~How you know it?~~ → How **do you know** it?
- ~~Who's umbrella is this?~~ → **Whose** umbrella is this?
- ~~Who did you give the keys?~~ → Who did you give the keys **to**? / **To whom** did you give the keys?
en:
## Subject and object questions
In a **subject** question the wh-word is the subject, so we do not use do.
> **Who called** you last night? **What happened** to your car? **Which team won** the cup?
In an **object** question we need an auxiliary and inversion.
> **Who did** you call? **What did** she say?
- ~~Who did call you?~~ → **Who called** you? (*did* appears only for emphasis).

## who and whom
**Whom** is the object form. It is formal and rare in speech. After a preposition formal English requires **whom**; in everyday speech the preposition moves to the end and **who** is used.
> **To whom** should I address it? (formal) / **Who** should I address it **to**? (neutral)
- ~~Whom called?~~ → **Who** called? (**whom** is never a subject)

## which and what
**Which** chooses from a limited, known set: Which of these routes is shorter? **What** is open: What kind of music do you like?
- **which of** + the / these / them: Which **of the** candidates impressed you?
- ~~What colour of car~~ → What **colour** is your car?

## how + adjective or adverb
**how long, how far, how often, how old, how tall, how well, how much / many**: How long does the conference last?
- **How come** + normal word order = «why on earth»: **How come** you never told me? (no did)
- **How about** + -ing: How about visiting the museum?
- **What is …like?** asks for a description; **How is …?** asks about health or progress; **How do you like …?** asks for an opinion.

## whose
**Whose** + noun: Whose idea was it? Without a noun: **Whose** is the red folder? Do not confuse it with **who's** (= who is).

## Emphasis
Add **on earth / in the world / ever**: **What on earth** are you doing?

## Common mistakes
- ~~How you know it?~~ → How **do you know** it?
- ~~Who's umbrella is this?~~ → **Whose** umbrella is this?
- ~~Who did you give the keys?~~ → Who did you give the keys **to**?
structure:
## Подлежащее и дополнение
| Тип | Порядок слов | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| К подлежащему | wh + V | Who called you? |
| К дополнению | wh + aux + S + V | Who did you call? |
| С предлогом (нейтр.) | wh + aux + S + V + prep | Who did you speak to? |
| С предлогом (формально) | prep + whom + aux + S + V | To whom did you speak? |
| How come | how come + S + V | How come you left? |

## which vs what
| Слово | Выбор | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| which | из известного набора | Which of these two? |
| what | из открытого набора | What kind of film? |

## How + ...
| Вопрос | О чём | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| how long | длительность, длина | How long is the film? |
| how far | расстояние | How far is it? |
| how often | частота | How often do you travel? |
| how much / many | количество | How many people came? |
| how + adj | степень | How tall is she? |
| what ... like | какой | What is she like? |
| how is / are | как дела | How is your brother? |

## whose
> **Whose** + noun + be ...? — Whose bag is this?
> **Whose** + be + noun? — Whose is this bag?

exercises.title: Вопросительное слово
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное вопросительное слово (who, whom, which, what, whose, how, how come).
exercises.example: ___ of the two candidates impressed you more? → **Which** of the two candidates impressed you more?

items.text: {{Whose}} turn is it to wash up?
To {{whom}} should the complaint be addressed?
{{Which}} of the two routes is shorter?
{{How}} far is it from here to the harbour?
{{How come}} you never told me about this?
{{Who|Whom}} did you give the keys to?
{{What}} kind of music do you listen to when you work?

exercises.title: Вопрос к подлежащему или к дополнению
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму глагола (do / did / does или основной глагол).

items.text: Which team {{won}} the cup last year?
How many people {{did}} you invite to the party?

items.q: ___ did you speak to at the reception?
items.why: Спрашиваем о человеке, в разговорной речи **who** + предлог в конце.

items.q: ___ of these two laptops would you recommend?

items.why: Спрашиваем о предпочтении (крепкий, с сахаром): **How do you like…?**
**How come** + прямой порядок слов, без did.
После предлога в начале вопроса формально нужна **whom**.
В вопросе к подлежащему нет did, и **whom** не бывает подлежащим.

options: How long does the film last?
items.why: Вопрос к дополнению-обстоятельству: how long + **does** + подлежащее + глагол.

items.q: How ___ is the Eiffel Tower? — About 330 metres.
___ is the capital of Australia, Sydney or Canberra?

exercises.title: Задайте вопрос
exercises.instruction: Составьте вопрос по заданию в скобках или по предложению.

items.prompt: Mark invited Elena to the conference. (спросите о том, кого он пригласил) → ...
answers: Who did Mark invite to the conference?
Whom did Mark invite to the conference?

items.prompt: Somebody has taken my umbrella. (спросите о том, кто) → ...
The red folder belongs to Dmitri. (спросите о владельце) → Whose ...
answers: Whose folder is the red one?

items.prompt: The conference lasts three days. (спросите о длительности) → How ...
answers: How long does the conference last?

items.prompt: Of the three candidates, only Olga was shortlisted. → Which ...
answers: Which of the three candidates was shortlisted?
Which of the candidates was shortlisted?

items.prompt: He was talking to the new director. (спросите, с кем) → ...

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите вопросы, используя слова в скобках.

items.prompt: Как часто ты ездишь в командировки? (how often / go / on business trips)
answers: How often do you go on business trips?

items.prompt: Почему же ты мне не сказал? (how come)
answers: How come you didn't tell me?
How come you did not tell me?

items.prompt: Какой из этих двух отчётов вам нужен? (which / need)
answers: Which of these two reports do you need?
Which of the two reports do you need?
What is your new boss like?

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Придумайте и напишите вопросы к собеседнику, используя слова в скобках.

items.prompt: Спросите, как долго человек работает или учится на своём месте. (how long)
items.sample: How long have you been working at this company?

items.prompt: Спросите, из какого города человек, и чем он славится. (what / which)
items.sample: Which city are you from, and what is it famous for?

items.prompt: Спросите, чей это был совет, который помог. (whose)
items.sample: Whose advice helped you most when you were choosing your career?

items.prompt: Спросите, как человек относится к новому проекту. (how do you like)
items.sample: How do you like the new project so far?

items.prompt: Спросите, с кем человек обсуждал свои планы. (to whom / who ... to)
items.sample: Who did you discuss your plans with?

items.prompt: Спросите, почему вдруг изменилось расписание. (how come)
items.sample: How come the schedule has changed again?
